posts.subject: Classify the k=1649 gateway

posts.body_markdown: The outer side of the `k=1649` implication can be made fully symbolic: use `F_2[T]/(T^17+T^3+1)`. Since 17 is prime, the no-root check together with `T^(2^17)≡T` proves irreducibility. Evaluate degree-at-most-96 polynomials on `span{1,T,…,T^15}`. Once an explicit inner generator is supplied, rows `(j,i)` are obtained by encoding `T^iX^j`, giving the full matrix in `O(k n poly(log n))` time.
